name: log_glucose
description: Log a glucose reading the user measured, in the account's unit unless another unit is given.

name: log_meal
description: Log something the user ate or drank, described in their words, with carbs if given.

name: log_exercise
description: Log a physical activity, finished (with duration) or in progress.

name: finish_exercise
description: Mark the end of an activity that was logged as in progress.

name: log_sleep
description: Log when the user went to bed or woke up.

name: log_insulin
description: Log insulin the user says they took (units and kind). It does not suggest or calculate doses.

name: log_medication
description: Log a medication the user says they took, in their words.

name: log_hypo_treatment
description: Log what the user took to treat a low, with carbs if they say so.

name: log_note
description: Log a free note in the diary.

name: delete_entry
description: Delete an entry logged by hand or by an assistant, by its id.

name: get_profile
description: The account's glucose unit, target range, time zone and what the plan allows to read.

name: get_glucose
description: Glucose readings of a period (default: last 24 h).

name: get_entries
description: Meals, exercise, insulin, medication, sleep and notes of a period (default: last 24 h).

name: get_stats
description: Statistics of a period: time in range, mean, variability, episodes, by time of day and weekday/weekend.

name: get_meal_response
description: What happened in the user's own data after similar meals they logged before (past data, not a prediction).

name: get_entry_effect
description: How glucose moved after one diary entry: baseline, peak, changes at 30-180 min.

name: get_exercise_summary
description: Days with exercise versus days without in a period, and by kind of activity.
